tool.name: CImg denoising

param.name: first
param.label: Number of the first image (0: default value)
param.help: Number of the first image (0: default value)

param.name: last
param.label: Number of the last image (depth or time: default value)
param.help: Number of the last image (depth or time: default value)

param.name: alpha
param.label: Alpha mixing of input/output images [0. - 1.] (0.: default value)
param.help: Alpha mixing of input/output images [0. - 1.] (0.: default value)

param.name: scale
param.label: Resize the volume in the range [0.5 - 1.5] (1.: default value)
param.help: Resize the volume in the range [0.5 - 1.5] (1.: default value)

param.name: range
param.label: Automatic intensity scaling (-1) or manual scaling
param.help: Automatic intensity scaling (-1) or manual scaling

param.name: ng
param.label: Add artificial Gaussian noise before applying the algorithm
param.help: Add artificial Gaussian noise before applying the algorithm

param.name: np
param.label: Add artificial Poisson noise before applying the algorithm
param.help: Add artificial Poisson noise before applying the algorithm

param.name: msg
param.label: Adjust manually the assumed Gaussian noise standard deviation
param.help: Adjust manually the assumed Gaussian noise standard deviation

param.name: stab
param.label: Variance stabilization for Poisson noise removal
param.help: Variance stabilization for Poisson noise removal

param.name: patch
param.label: Half size of the patch (NLMeans, PEWA, OWF, SAFIR, DCT, Wiener)
param.help: Half size of the patch (NLMeans, PEWA, OWF, SAFIR, DCT, Wiener)

param.name: neigh
param.label: Half size of the neighborhood (NLMeans, PEWA, OWF, SAFIR, DCT, Median, Bilateral)
param.help: Half size of the neighborhood (NLMeans, PEWA, OWF, SAFIR, DCT, Median, Bilateral)

param.name: denoisep
param.label: Denoising parameter (NLMeans: 3.5 | DCT: 3.0 | Wiener: 1.25 | Bilateral: 2.0 | Gaussian: 1.0 | TV: 6.0 | SV: 6.0 | HV: 6.0)
param.help: Denoising parameter (NLMeans: 3.5 | DCT: 3.0 | Wiener: 1.25 | Bilateral: 2.0 | Gaussian: 1.0 | TV: 6.0 | SV: 6.0 | HV: 6.0)

param.name: sparsep
param.label: Sparsity parameter (SV and HV algorithms) in the range [0.1 - 0.9]
param.help: Sparsity parameter (SV and HV algorithms) in the range [0.1 - 0.9]

tool.help: Denoise 2D+T images corrupted by Gaussian or Poisson noise with patch based methods and basic methods and variational methods.
